title: MDA for Virome Analysis
author: Frej Larsen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b42uqyew
materials: Place materials that tolerate UV-treatment in fume hood and turn on the UV light and recirculation for 30 minutes before use.
Denature template DNA by 95 degrees for 3 minutes in a ThermoCycler. Directly after, put the samples back on ice

steps.title: Prepare DNA Template
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA sample in a PCR tube and mix by pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ng DNA in 10 µL MQ water, or if the sample concentration is below 1 ng/ul, add 10 µL of undiluted sample.

steps.title: Add Denaturation Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL denaturation buffer to a PCR tube.

steps.title: Transfer Sample to MDA Cake
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample content to the MDA cake tube, keeping both on ice during the process.

substeps.instruction: Add all 20 µL of sample content to the MDA cake tube.

steps.title: Seal and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Seal the tube with the provided lid and briefly centrifuge the sample.

steps.title: Run Thermocycler Program
steps.instruction: Run the sample on a ThermoCycler using the specified temperature program.

steps.title: Purify or Store Samples
steps.instruction: Process the resulting samples for storage or further analysis.
